title: 06/27/2025 - Software Updates
content:
## 06/27/2025 - Software Updates


Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000105098

We made updates to several default widgets this week. If you customized any of these widgets and want to update them, you can find the latest code in the corresponding default widget. Please remember that if you have a custom version of any of these widgets, the latest updates will not be pushed to your website.

- Fixed an issue that prevented the Bookmark Favorites Add-On from working properly when the "Enable Search Results Cache" Post Type Setting was enabled in some cases.

- Updated the 'Required Label' to no longer display in the Category dropdown fields in the Get Matched Form when the label is empty. Widget Involved: Bootstrap - Lead Form - Extra Settings

- Fixed an issue with uploading member profile images smaller than 200 by 200 pixels when the "Skip Image Size Warning for Profile Photos and Logos" Advanced Setting was enabled. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Account - Profile Image Upload

- Trimmed any trailing whitespaces from data entered into the Post Categories field when editing Post Types in the Admin.

- Implemented a security update to the Newsletter Signup module on the frontend. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Module - Newsletter Actions

- Fixed an issue with the search results of Post keyword searches .

- Fixed an issue where the 'Member Profile Analytics' Add-On was counting post views when the post's author visited their own post's details page on the frontend.

- Fixed an issue that prevented custom dropdown, radio button, and checkbox form field values from displaying correctly in email templates in some cases.

- Fixed an issue that prevented the "Member Credits: Select Transaction Types Credits Can Be Applied To" setting from working properly when attempting to pay subscription invoices from the Member Dashboard when the "Recurring Membership Plan Payments" option was unchecked.
